title: pyrus communis var. variegata
intro: Pyrus communis var. variegata, commonly known as the Variegated Pear, is a variety of the pear tree (Pyrus communis) characterized by its striking white and green striped leaves. The health benefits of Pyrus communis var. variegata include its potential to help lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, aid in digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus communis var. variegata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
